description: Machine-readable integration and connector safety guardrail. It keeps the connector app reserved, business events notification-only, and future adapter boundaries contract-first.
connector_readme_required_phrases: Reserved future Frappe app for external-system adapters.
Define public API or event contracts under `contracts/` before implementing an adapter.
Store external identifiers and sync status
Expose failures as reviewable ERP records
Never let an external AI tool directly post financial, inventory, payroll, permission, or compliance changes.
event_contract_required_snippets: minimal, non-PII payloads and remain idempotent
Optional request or job id used for idempotent downstream handling.
required_doc_phrases: Business events are notifications. They do not authorize ERP mutations.
New event types require a contract update, a producer/consumer test, and a security review for tenant, role, audit, and idempotency boundaries.
Contracts are versioned before implementation so industry apps and external connectors stay independently deployable.
Never add unversioned webhooks, direct ERP mutation instructions, production payload examples, customer exports, or secrets to a public contract.
